headline: Apple Music To Add Markers To AI-Generated Tracks, But Putting The Onus on Record Labels
body: Apple Music has confirmed it will attach "Made With AI" labels to tracks generated on platforms such as Suno. However, the company is shifting the compliance burden onto record labels and distributors, who must supply disclosure metadata themselves

headline: Round Hill Music Sues Suno and Anthropic for Up to $1 Billion Each
body: Music publisher Round Hill Music has filed copyright infringement lawsuits against AI firms Suno and Anthropic, seeking statutory damages of up to $150,000 per work — potentially totalling close to $1 billion against each company.

headline: Spotify Board Approves $1.5 Billion Boost to Share Buyback Programme
body: Spotify's board has approved a $1.5 billion expansion of its share repurchase programme, taking total buyback capacity to roughly $2.2 billion once the $723 million left from the prior authorisation is included.
